strategy: First stage continuity and narrative function, only then search/download. One character/world for room scenes; independent symbolic sources only when semantics are verifiable. The slots contain no acquired media.

global_continuity.person: same unrecognizable adult, charcoal clothing and hands; do not switch known face between clips
global_continuity.room: same modest room, window, worn wood desk, dark notebook, warm-neutral lamp
global_continuity.time_of_day: night through dawn, no harsh studio daylight
global_continuity.camera: real captured motion, restrained 9:16; no artificial zoom of tiny photos passed as film
global_continuity.prohibition: no readable written material, visible brands, logos, different foreground faces, unexplained cross-world costume, reenactment labeled as historical fact

historical_rights_gate: Pexels stock allowed for commercial projects subject to third-party rights; not public domain and not evidence of Pexels source being licensed for depiction of identified person in a negative context
